title: 首相日々　2日
extracted_text: ベトナム・ハノイの首相府で歓迎式典。レ・ミン・フン首相と首脳会談少人数会合。同拡大会合。文書交換式、共同記者発表。 国家主席府でトー・ラム共産党書記長兼国家主席と会談、昼食会。ベトナム国家大学ハノイ校で外交政策に関する演説。国会議事堂でチャン・タイン・マン国会議…
translated_text: Welcome ceremony at the Prime Minister's Office in Hanoi, Vietnam. Summit meeting with Prime Minister Le Minh Phong in a small group. Followed by an expanded meeting. Document signing ceremony and joint press conference. Meeting with Party Secretary and State President To Lam at the Presidential Palace, followed by a luncheon. Speech on foreign policy at Vietnam National University, Hanoi campus. Meeting with National Assembly Chairman Tran Thanh Man at the National Assembly...
